rationale: Exercise arithmetic and logical instruction decoding and register selection.
Exercise conditional branches, direct jumps, and indirect jumps.
Exercise memory queue selection, memory size and signedness, and atomic-operation legality.
Exercise multiply and divide issue and functional-unit controls.
Exercise floating-point arithmetic, division, and register-class controls.

The CPU program exercises CSR accesses. The port test checks instruction forwarding, read legality, and zero versus nonzero register and immediate source fields on a read-only CSR.
Check the response to allowed and denied fences, and look at the address and ASID operand-presence flags for allowed fences.
